field_conflicts.description: The source specifies255 draws but its94/94/47/16/4/1 occupancy profile totals257 entries. Exact stars-and-bars gives C(510,255), not the printed C(510,256). Under the stated iid model an all-singleton counter vector has probability255!/256^255≈2^-364.003713; a Poisson-typical profile is not an individual maximum-probability vector. Thus the printed2^-283.6 bound is retained as a disputed argument, not a certified AES bound.
